documentation.content: The orchestrator returned a degraded answer (HTTP 200, so Cloud Run error metrics do not show it). Open the orchestrator logs for the alert window and find the 'ask degraded' line: its trigger and capability say why. Take its trace_id and read the rest of that request's lines. Degraded causes are in ADR-088. A trace_id starting 'alerttest-' is the synthetic test entry (ADR-112).
